rv.q: The storytelling in Sting is sharp and often arresting, even when it overreaches.
As a modern Gothic exploring gender issues, it works very well.
Beautifully written, brilliantly performed and directed with real confidence, Sting is another triumph for the Young Vic.
The entire execution matched the impressiveness of the hard-hitting storytelling.

cn.t: Critics praise the striking archive setting and engaging performances, finding the show a visually impressive and theatrically compelling exploration of witchcraft history that effectively blends historical resonance with contemporary relevance.
